comments: Uses axe-core 4.12.1 rules plus its own checks. A clean report means no automatically detectable failures in the states and passes that ran; it does not test with screen readers and is not a conformance claim. It also ships an agent skill; the CLI is the evaluation tool being submitted.
features: Node CLI that audits pages in Chromium with axe-core across five passes (default, dark mode, forced colors, reduced motion, 320px viewport) and built interaction states. Adds its own focus-trap, keyboard and focus-visible checks, diffs runs as fixed/new/remaining, and lists what still needs manual testing. Not a conformance claim.
title: a11y-loop
